title: Seed model registration and stable pinflow for embedding-reranker artifacts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: We need a deterministic, auditable path for registering embedding and reranker model artifacts into the catalog, generating performance profiles, and emitting a stable pin that downstream serving and Dedicated/private deploys can rely on. Current onboarding is ad-hoc: artifacts are produced by different CI jobs, profiles are uploaded manually, and pin names collide after repeated re-publishes. This ticket seeds an automated registry flow and a pin naming strategy that supports reproducible rollouts and cross-arch compatibility checks.

Scope:
- Implement a registration producer that consumes build artifacts (model weights + metadata + quantization manifest) and writes a content-addressable model record into the catalog service.
- Generate canonical performance profile bundles for embedding and pairwise reranker variants (float16, q4_0, q4_1) with standardized metrics (throughput @ batch N, p50/p90 latency for the typical request shape).
- Emit a stable semantic pin (format: modelname@<short-fingerprint>-pin) and publish a pin manifest that maps pin -> artifact id + profile id + compatible hardware tags.
- Integrate lightweight admission tests: profile smoke (latency/throughput), deterministic output checksum on sample inputs, and cross-arch kernel compatibility tag.
- Publish telemetry hooks: publish a dashboard link and generate structured events for the Console (model.registered, profile.published, pin.created).

Non-goals:
- Full canary rollout orchestration (handled in separate rollout ticket).
- Deep quantization research — we rely on existing quant profiles produced by the model build jobs.

Acceptance criteria:
- New registry job can be invoked from CI and creates a content-addressable model record in the catalog.
- For at least two example artifacts (an embedding model and a pairwise reranker), the pipeline creates a perf profile bundle and a stable pin that resolves to the published artifact and profile.
- A simple admission gate passes/fails based on predefined thresholds and is recorded in the audit log.
- Console receives structured events for registration/publish and the model page shows the pin and profile mapping.
- Documentation: short runbook for SRE/Oncall and a quickstart doc for model teams.

Success metrics:
- First-time onboarding time reduced from ~3 days to <8 hours for internal model teams.
- Zero pin naming collisions observed in the next 30 model publishes.

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: Content-addressing can change if build metadata is non-deterministic. Mitigation: canonicalize metadata fields and drop volatile fields before hashing.
- Risk: Incompatible quant profiles across architectures. Mitigation: require compatibility tags and fail registration if compatibility matrix is empty.

Rollout plan:
1) Implement registry producer and profile bundler in staging and run against two test artifacts. (this ticket)
2) Add admission gate and telemetry, iterate on thresholds with ML team.
3) Soft-launch: allow model teams to opt-in for next 2 weeks.
4) Promote to default path and deprecate ad-hoc publish scripts.

Related artifacts: design doc (Drive): https://drive.redwood.ai/docs/embed-rerank-registry-design, perf dashboard (Grafana): https://dash.redwood.ai/d/emb-rerank/profiles, example PR scaffold: https://github.com/redwood-inference/registry/pull/800
